name: Brastlewark Businessman
text:
**Brastlewark Businessman** (race trait; Gnome)

Your time among the Brastlewark elite has led to an extensive knowledge of alchemy and ready connections in the trade. You gain a +2 trait bonus on all Craft (alchemy) checks.
